title: Canonical Header Call Machine
statement: For every machine format $F$, there exist a finite Turing machine $C$ over the Boolean alphabet with at least one work tape, entry and exit states, and a constant $a\\in\\mathbb N$. For every Boolean input $\\alpha$, there is a time $t$ with $0<t\\le a(|\\alpha|+1)$ such that the configuration at time $t$ has the exit state, the canonical header of $\\alpha$ on tape zero, and empty words on the other work tapes, with input head at position $1$ and empty output; at each intermediate time $0<u<t$ the state is not the exit state.
hypotheses_covered: final configuration contains the canonical header on tape zero and empty words elsewhere, input head at 1, and empty output
